text: did someone just change the snap? i was literally in the middle of putting walls together and now the walls dont snap to the ones i was just editing. this was after you fixed it lmao
resolution: Fixed snap regression from the wall-on-floor changes: edge snap now stacks only from actual top faces, while wall side/end faces keep the target wall base Y for wall-to-wall continuation. Floor/roof side faces and beside-floor ground hits remain blocked as alternate wall-on-floor anchors. Added a regression test for wall side-face edge snap. Verified build-snap 16/16, build-placed 45/45, and full hmsc-int esbuild bundle.
